items.title: Scripture
items.body: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest. — Exodus 33:14 (KJV)

items.title: Farmer's Almanac tip
items.body: When the clocks change, swap the batteries in your smoke alarms.

items.title: Joke of the day
items.body: Two boys were bragging. One said, "My daddy's a Baptist preacher and he knows everything." The other said, "My daddy's a Methodist preacher and he knows even more." A third boy said, "My daddy's a farmer, and when he doesn't know something, he says it's going to rain."
